# apikit — llms.txt

> Concise machine-readable index of `apikit` (https://github.com/KooshaPari/apikit),
> the direct continuation of the now-archived Apisync project
> (https://github.com/KooshaPari/Apisync).

## Project

- Name: apikit
- Type: Rust library crate (HTTP toolkit — REST, GraphQL, WebSocket adapters)
- Edition: 2021
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- Source repo: https://github.com/KooshaPari/apikit
- Source-of-truth repo (archived): https://github.com/KooshaPari/Apisync
- Migration date: 2026-06-20
- Source archive (audit trail): /tmp/apisync-final

## Layout

- src/ — library source (REST / GraphQL / WebSocket adapters, application layer, domain, infrastructure)
- benches/ — Criterion benchmarks
- fuzz/ — fuzz targets
- tests/ — unit + integration tests
- .github/workflows/ — 12 CI workflows absorbed from Apisync (ci, release, audit, cargo-deny, coverage, quality-gate, sast, scorecard, security-deep-scan, security-guard, trufflehog, pages-deploy)
- docs/ — apikit specs (SPEC.md, FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.md, TEST_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md)
- docs/governance/ — absorbed Apisync governance: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ADR.md, README.apisync.md, STATUS.apisync.md, PLAN.apisync.md, PRD.apisync.md, SPEC.apisync.md, FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.apisync.md, TEST_COVERAGE_MATRIX.apisync.md, CHANGELOG.apisync.md, adr/ (5 ADRs), .vitepress/config.mts
- docs/sessions/ — absorbed Apisync journeys/, stories/, traceability/
- docs/research/ — absorbed Apisync research (SOTA.md)
- config/ — reserved for runtime configuration
- CHANGELOG.md — apikit's own changelog (dated 2026-06-20 migration entry)

## Public API surface (top-level)

- apikit::adapters::rest — typed REST client
- apikit::adapters::graphql — async GraphQL client
- apikit::adapters::websocket — WebSocket send/receive
- apikit::application::router — request routing
- apikit::application::handler — handler dispatch
- apikit::application::middleware — composable middleware pipeline
- apikit::domain — domain types
- apikit::infrastructure — logging, config adapters
